record.question: Who is the minister in-charge of Power and Electricity Department in Mizoram?
record.explanation: Answer D: R.Lalzirliana. The original Mizoram Department of Information & Public Relations item identifies Minister R. Lalzirliana with the Power & Electricity Department; that matches option (d), index 3. Reference: https://dipr.mizoram.gov.in/post/minister-r-lalzirliana-hovin-power-electricity-department-hnathawh-dan-thlirlet. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
